products.what_it_changes: Dealer/maker claims: more braking surface from the 270mm rotor, smoother modulation than OEM and better pad cooling. Laser-cut stainless, double-disc ground, heat treated, made in Spain.
products.supporting_parts: Kit includes the solid-mount 270mm Wave rotor and a CNC 6061-T6 aluminium caliper relocation bracket. Pads not listed as included.
products.caveats: Dealer says it fits ONLY bikes with Brembo calipers, not Braktec/Magura. Dealer also lists Husqvarna TC/TX/FC/FX 2022-2026 (asterisked, unexplained) and GasGas 125-450 2021-2026 except EC; those were left out because some of those years shipped with Braktec calipers. Galfer's own application PDF could not be opened, so family wording was expanded by us.

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: 270mm floating Wave rotor for more stopping power; race-team tested for track and trail.
products.supporting_parts: 270mm floating rotor, pads (page says both semi-metallic and HH sintered), 6061-T6 aluminium relocation bracket.
products.caveats: The Cycle Gear listing is a used item marked 'previously installed', and it is out of stock. The page shows no model or year fitment, only a Honda maker tag, so check KITOS12 fitment with Galfer before use.

products.what_it_changes: Larger 240mm rear rotor; the usual reason riders fit one is more rear brake power and heat capacity. The dealer page makes no performance claims.
products.supporting_parts: Includes DF607WS disc, SP043 caliper mount with 20/25mm bushes, FD291G1396 pads.
products.caveats: UK dealer lists 'KTM from 2010, Husqvarna from 2014' only. Husqvarna and GasGas models with Braktec rear calipers may not take it, so they were left off. The page calls the disc a 'Front Disc' in the kit contents, which looks like a typo.

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: bolts in place of the OEM front rotor with no spacers; laser-cut 420 stainless, heat treated; vented slots for cooling and water clearing; 'drastically increase brake lever feel, modulation, and brake torque'.
products.supporting_parts: Sold each. Fresh pads advised with any new rotor.
products.caveats: Retailer fitment table, read on 2026-10-15. Year coverage is patchy for some models: Husqvarna FC 2026-2027, FX 450 2025+, GasGas MC 450F 2027 and 4-stroke MC/EX 2021-2023 are not listed. Price not shown.

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: up to 35% more braking performance than stock, up to 20% lighter, Flame pattern for cooling. Floating stainless outer ring on a billet aluminium carrier.
products.supporting_parts: Includes 270mm Flame rotor, billet caliper relocation bracket and Moto-Master Nitro Sport pads.
products.caveats: Retailer fitment list mixes in other makes that link to separate kits; only the Honda entries were used. The page shows both in-stock and out-of-stock. Rebate advertised.

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: up to 35% more braking performance than stock and up to 20% lighter. 270mm floating Flame rotor.
products.supporting_parts: Includes 270mm Flame rotor, billet caliper bracket and Nitro Sport pads.
products.caveats: Page title says 2020-2027 but the Yamaha list runs to 2026. YZ250F 2020 and YZ450FX 2024+ are not listed. Stock status conflicts on the page.

products.product: Batfly S3 Oversized Front Rotor Kit 270mm
products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: semi-floating design (outer track riveted to carrier in 3 areas), Batfly grooves self-ventilate; 'best compromise between a fixed and floating rotor'.
products.supporting_parts: 270mm rotor, mounting bracket and CM46 sintered race pads included.
products.caveats: Retailer shows no per-bike fitment ('select your vehicle') and no MFR part number; out of stock. A Motomentum search result titled the S3 270 front kit as MPN OKS309, but that page was not opened, so the number and its fitment are unconfirmed.

products.product: MXS Race Series Front Brake Pads

fits.notes: KX450 listed 2019-2023 only on this page

products.what_it_changes: EBC claims: sintered copper-alloy race compound made in EBC's US plant, sharp initial bite, high durability in mud and dust; diamond-ground surface for fast bed-in.
products.supporting_parts: EBC says most MXS pads ship with new slider pins.
products.caveats: Off-road race use only, not R90/TUV approved. J&P fitment list was truncated after Kawasaki, so Yamaha/Suzuki entries were not seen. EBC's own product page (ebcbrakes.com/products/mxs-series-moto-x-race-pads/) lists no part numbers; its Part Finder was not checked.

products.product: MXS Race Series Front Brake Pads
products.what_it_changes: EBC claims: sintered copper-alloy MX race compound, sharp initial bite, fade resistant, consistent across heat cycles.
products.caveats: Retailer fitment list cut off after Husqvarna FC450, so KTM, Husqvarna TC/TX/FX and others were not visible. MXS181 is the Brembo-pattern pad, but KTM fitment is not confirmed here. Bikes with Braktec front calipers (some GasGas/Husqvarna years) may take a different pad. Check the EBC Part Finder.

products.product: MXS Race Series Rear Brake Pads
products.what_it_changes: EBC claims: sintered copper-alloy race pad with aggressive feel and sharp initial bite; high durability off-road.
products.caveats: Off-road race use only, not R90/TUV. Retailer list was truncated (258 vehicles claimed). YZ450FX 2024+ not shown.

variants: 10mm piston, 16mm centre distance, integrated reservoir, natural aluminium
products.what_it_changes: Brembo/retailer claims: 10mm piston with 16mm centre distance for a prompt, progressive lever response; can be paired with the newer PF2X24 calipers.
products.supporting_parts: DOT 4 fluid only (not mineral oil). Front line routing and lever fitment will vary by bike.
products.caveats: Retailer says 'universal for all motocross bikes with single-disc brake systems', with no per-model fitment. Fitting to Japanese bikes or Braktec-equipped bikes means swapping the master cylinder; check line, banjo and switch compatibility. Italian retailer price includes VAT; separate courier shipping is EUR 65.

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: braided stainless with PTFE inner liner for minimal expansion, giving a firmer, more progressive lever than stock.
products.supporting_parts: Banjo bolts and washers included. Lifetime warranty claimed.
products.caveats: Cycle Gear fitment for this single part number spans dozens of makes and decades (Honda, KTM, Husqvarna, Kawasaki, GasGas), which looks like a family-page fitment rather than per-line data. Confirm the exact FK003D line number for a bike with Galfer.

variants: 022080 = CR High bend (A800 B95 C71 E60 mm)
022083 = SX Race bend (A800 B87 C54.5 E54)
products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: carbon-fibre cores inside 7000-series aluminium tube allow thinner walls; up to 20% lighter than conventional 1-1/8 inch bars; impact-absorbing flex; 220mm 'Control+' clamp-to-control space (up to 40mm more) for map switches and starter buttons.
products.supporting_parts: Needs 1-1/8 inch (28.6mm) bar clamps; most current MX bikes have them stock.
products.caveats: Bar ends do not accept wraparound handguards or bar-end accessories. Universal part; choose bend by rise and sweep, not by bike.
rider_feedback: Cycle Gear (2026-10-15): average 5/5 stars; review count shown inconsistently

variants: 028960 = Windham/Suzuki Mid bend (24MX article no.; A800 B99 C70 E53 mm)
Other bends listed by 24MX without part numbers: Carmichael, Henry/Reed
products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: lockable crossbar switches between a stiffer locked feel and a softer unlocked feel in seconds (24MX states unlocked is 32% softer). 2000-series T6 aluminium, about 940-953 g.
products.supporting_parts: 1-1/8 inch bar clamps. Bar pad and end plugs included; Fuzion uses a specific round bar pad.
products.caveats: Universal. Dimension labels on 24MX are inconsistent (B vs E swapped in the variant name).

products.what_it_changes: Grips lock on with clamps, so no glue or safety wire, and can be swapped trackside. ODI claims '100% slip-free'.
products.supporting_parts: Includes a throttle tube and cams: 4-stroke cams B, J, K, M and 2-stroke cams C, D. Some bikes need a separate V2 throttle cam (ODI hook-up guide).
products.caveats: ODI says V2 lock-ons 'do not fit all models'. Check the cam against ODI's throttle cam guide for your bike. Fits 7/8 inch bars or oversize bars tapering to 7/8 inch.
rider_feedback: Cycle Gear (2026-10-15): 4.5/5 from 19 reviews, no review text shown

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: lever flexes away from the bar in a crash so the brake keeps working after a bar-bending hit; reach adjuster; billet CNC knee; made in USA.
products.supporting_parts: Direct fit to stock Nissin master cylinder.
products.caveats: No ARC part number on the Cycle Gear page (item P308085). Price shown as 'from $84.95'; varies by blade material.
rider_feedback: Cycle Gear (2026-10-15): 4.5/5 from 7 reviews, no review text shown

products.product: Flex Clutch Lever for Brembo Master Cylinder
products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: flexes away from the bar in a crash; reach adjuster; direct fit to stock hydraulic Brembo clutch master cylinders.
products.supporting_parts: Only for Brembo hydraulic clutch masters, not Magura.
products.caveats: Retailer list was cut off; KTM and Husqvarna TC/TX entries were not visible even though the title names KTM. The FC/GasGas years listed cover bikes that ran Magura or Braktec hydraulics in some years, so check which master cylinder your bike has. No ARC part number shown (item P308132).

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: third-generation variable-rate throttle; swappable cams change how quickly the throttle opens, to soften or sharpen response.
products.supporting_parts: Kit includes +3 inch longer cables per the title; full contents not shown.
products.caveats: Retailer gives only family fitment (KTM/Husqvarna 250-450 2015-2021), no model list and no MFR part number. Price is only in page metadata. A 2006-2015 KTM version with PN 01-2968 showed up in search, but that is out of scope.

products.caveats: IMS page meta description lists different year ranges than the visible fitment; visible list used. Lifetime warranty covers broken pegs only.

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: front slider lasts 'up to 3 times longer' than others; inner guide wing keeps the chain aligned and cuts tire buzz; damping pads reduce chain slap; Powerlip lower pad reduces drag; low-profile reinforced FX rear guide; RMS plastic returns to shape after hits.
products.supporting_parts: Kit = Baja front slider, Powerlip lower roller/frame pad, FX rear chain guide, new mounting hardware.
products.caveats: Dealer page also says 'No vehicle fitment set for this product yet'. Also lists 2022-2025 KTM 250/450 SX-F Factory Edition, 2022 Husqvarna Rockstar and 2023 GasGas Factory Edition. Prices in CAD.

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: replaces a worn guide, slider and roller; friction-reducing plastic cuts chain drag; rear guide takes sprockets up to 2 teeth larger than OEM.
products.supporting_parts: Kit = Dirt Cross front slider, Powerlip lower roller with sound-damping pads, Factory Edition 1 rear chain guide.
products.caveats: No MFR part number shown (item P1037765). Title says 2021-2024 but the image file says 2021-2023.

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: one-piece moulded carbon/biaxial glass/Kevlar blend with epoxy finish for impact resistance; lighter than aluminium plates.
products.supporting_parts: Hardware included. Clutch cover guard not included.
products.caveats: For 2022 it fits only Factory/Rockstar Edition models. Listed years have gaps (FC 450 2026, FX 450 2025-2026). No MFR part number (item P1057592). Out of stock.
rider_feedback: Cycle Gear (2026-10-15): 4.5/5 from 4 reviews, no text shown

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: designed for the latest-generation KTM-group two-strokes; carbon/glass/Kevlar one-piece moulding.
products.supporting_parts: Hardware included.
products.caveats: Title says 2023-2025 but the fitment table shows mostly 2023-2024. Price shown as both $219.95 and $221.95, depending on linkage guard option. No MFR part number (item P1087690).

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: smooth seamless carbon plate protecting engine and frame.
products.caveats: RevZilla gives only family fitment in the title (Yamaha 250-450 2019-2023), and the YZ450F changed chassis for 2023, so models were not expanded. Price only in metadata (19995, probably $199.95).

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: aircraft aluminium plate shields engine from rocks and stumps; smooth underside slides over logs; oil drain hole.
products.supporting_parts: All mounting hardware included.
products.caveats: No MFR part number (item P1130290).

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: plastic plate (about 96% plastic, 4% steel) glides over whoops, rocks and logs; extended coverage of side cases, water pump and footpeg frame area; exhaust cutouts for airflow and washing; limits mud packing.
products.supporting_parts: Mounts through original frame holes; mounting kit included.
products.caveats: Maker page does not say which of the two part numbers is which colour. No price on maker page.

variants: 10-299 per MXA test; MXA describes MX and off-road (winglet) versions
products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: 6061-T6 aluminium; Rubber Isolator Mounting System lets the frame flex as designed; covers rails without overhang; pre-cut oil drain hole.
products.supporting_parts: One-piece CNC front bracket; threaded rear mounting.
products.caveats: Two different part numbers in two sources; unclear whether 10-299 is the off-road version. Fitment beyond 2024 not stated.
rider_feedback: MXA (2024-07-09): rated A, 'cheap insurance'; recheck bolts after the first ride, and MXA added rubber tape between plate and frame rails

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims (via press release): protects engine cases, oil filter and water pump; vented side tabs guard frame rails and footpeg mounts; rubber mounts reduce vibration; drain holes allow oil changes without removing the plate.
products.caveats: Not for TF 450-RC. Source is a Cycle News press item, not the maker's own page. 2026 fitment not stated.

products.what_it_changes: Wraparound aluminium-core handguards with plastic shields; protect levers and hands from roost and crash damage.
